researcher_notes: Unit = the updated ~26.2 MTPA expansion of Hazira (vs the earlier ~10 MTPA expansion proposal that stalled in 2021 over forest clearance). 2025 is the year the 26.2 MTPA expansion received environmental clearance from the MoEFCC Expert Appraisal Committee (meeting 2 Sept 2025) and was first widely publicly reported (3 independent outlets). CAVEAT: 2025 is the clearance/public-report year used as a proxy for the 'proposed' milestone; the underlying ToR/EIA proposal was almost certainly filed in 2024, but no verifier-passing source confirmed an earlier year. Treat 2025 as an upper bound, not a confirmed first-proposed year (hence tier low despite strong corroboration of the year itself).

Construction (actual). No verifier-passing source gives a construction-start / ground-breaking year. Anchors found: Port Service Agreement signed 6 Sept 2019 (East Coast Concessions / Kakinada Seaports); AP government comfort letter July 2021; project first described as 'under construction' in the 2024 IGU report (June 2024); commissioning targets slipped from mid-2022 to mid-2024 to 2026. Because the milestone needed is when site works/construction actually began and no source states it, UNRESOLVED.

Phase 2 = second FSRU expanding Swan LNG / Jafrabad from 5 to 10 MTPA. The phased 5-then-10 MTPA plan was part of the original project proposal, first reported in 2015 (Business Standard, 24 Nov 2015 - Swan Energy/Exmar FSRU terminal, '5 MTPA initial phase with potential to be increased to 10 MTPA'; cited via Wayback snapshot because the live business-standard.com page is bot-blocked 403 to the verifier). Only this one contemporaneous source carries the 2015 year (dmsprojects.net corroborates the 10 MTPA two-phase plan but was not verified for the year) -> single-source, tier low, independent false. Supporting context: 10 MTPA SPV Shareholders Agreement Oct 2017; Phase 1 FSRU Vasant 1 delivered Sept 2020.

Phase II = land-based onshore terminal expanding Jaigarh to 8 MTPA (Phase I = jetty-based FSRU). The two-phase 8 MTPA plan is described by Dec 2017 (offshore-technology) and on H-Energy's own site, but no verifier-passing source dates the Phase-II proposal to a specific year. Project / Phase-I anchors: PNGRB tie-in pipeline authorisation May 2015; jetty construction began Jan 2017; FSRU terminal inaugurated 2018; AG&P Pratham acquired the project Dec 2024. Because I could not verify the year the 8 MTPA onshore Phase II was first proposed (as distinct from Phase I milestones), UNRESOLVED.

Cancelled status is GEM's 'inferred 4 y' presumption (project auto-classified cancelled after ~4 years of inactivity), NOT a publicly announced cancellation. Petrogas (Isomeric / LEPL Ventures JV) signed an MOU with Krishnapatnam Port and the Andhra Pradesh government on 11 Jan 2016 for a 5-to-10 MTPA FSRU. No subsequent development and no source reports an actual cancellation/abandonment year, so no verifier-passing source can tie a cancellation YEAR to it. UNRESOLVED (inferred cancellation, never announced).

Cancelled status is GEM's 'inferred 4 y' presumption, NOT a publicly announced cancellation. H-Energy signed an MOU with Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, Kolkata on 23 Feb 2021 for an LNG regasification terminal (plus the Kukrahati-Itinda pipeline); no activity since. No public cancellation/abandonment announcement exists, so no verifier-passing source carries a cancellation YEAR. UNRESOLVED (inferred cancellation, never announced).

Cancelled status is GEM's 'inferred 4 y' presumption, NOT a publicly announced cancellation. SP Armada Clean Energy Ventures (Shapoorji Pallonji 51% / Bumi Armada) signed a 30-year license agreement with Mumbai Port Trust on 18 May 2021 for a 3.5 MTPA FSRU; no activity since (widely described as shelved ~2023, then presumed cancelled by inactivity). No public cancellation/abandonment announcement exists, so no verifier-passing source carries a cancellation YEAR. UNRESOLVED (inferred cancellation, never announced).
